title: Carathéodory's criterion (Simon 1.13, with Lemma 1.6)
statement: For every metric space (X, d) and every outer measure μ on X such that μ(A ∪ B) = μ(A) + μ(B) whenever A, B ⊆ X admit a real r > 0 with r ≤ d(a, b) for all a ∈ A, b ∈ B, every Borel set E ⊆ X is μ-measurable in Carathéodory's sense (μ.IsCaratheodory E).
